name: Tidewater Renewables Ltd.
summary: Tidewater Renewables Ltd. engages in production of renewable fuel in North America. Its flagship asset is the renewable diesel & renewable hydrogen complex that is located adjacent to the Prince George Refinery. It intends to focus on the production of low carbon fuels, including renewable diesel, renewable hydrogen, and renewable natural gas. Tidewater Renewables Ltd. was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada. Tidewater Renewables Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Tidewater Midstream and Infrastructure Ltd.
